description: Would send to Kettleby, and would not pretend the answer had come.
name: George Bryan

description: Said he would open his own doors, and was not taken as the vote.
name: James Burbage

description: Asked for the peace in writing, called Margery in, and set the July question without an answer.
name: John Heminges

description: Called the yard dry tinder, from nine years on the stair.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Stayed, was bored, and did not decide.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Said tomorrow's safe house is a shut one, and left Monday as Monday.
name: William Shakespeare
